definitions.gloss: decorative tile at a roof's ridge ends
definitions.explanation: A large ornamental tile placed at the ends of a traditional roof ridge, often carved with a demon or lion face. Traditionally believed to ward off evil spirits and fire, much like a gargoyle.

examples.japanese: {鬼瓦|おにがわら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: To look at a ridge-end tile.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鬼瓦|おにがわら}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{迫力|はくりょく}→迫力：14310_hakuryoku⟧がある。
examples.english: This temple's ridge-end tile is quite striking.

examples.japanese: {鬼瓦|おにがわら}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{魔除|まよ}け→魔除け：20337_mayoke⟧として⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両端|りょうたん}→両端：11356_ryoutan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}かれる→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: Ridge-end tiles are placed at both ends of the roof to ward off evil.

notes:
USAGE:
Despite the name (⟦{鬼|おに}→鬼：02184_oni⟧ = demon/ogre), many {鬼瓦|おにがわら} depict lions, waves, or family crests instead of a demon face; all serve the same protective, apotropaic role.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鬼瓦|おにがわら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to install a ridge-end tile (during construction)
- {鬼瓦|おにがわら}⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧: a craftsman who makes ridge-end tiles

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{瓦|かわら}→瓦：03902_kawara⟧: roof tile (general term)
- ⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧: roof
